name: Ebba
title: Factor of the Charter
examine: Amberford sent her north eleven years ago to count timber for a season. She has counted every stick that left since, and she has stopped talking about the season.
lines: The Charter buys volume. The Crown buys the one tree in a hundred. Both of us pay late.
Coin goes in the strongroom. The strongroom is the only thing in this building Ospren and I agree about.
Cormund taught me the ledger hand. Amberford, the bank on the Round. Tell him it is cold.
